business_problem: When ZF Group made Power Platform available to all employees, adoption quickly accelerated across the company.
solution_summary: ZF Friedrichshafen AG built a Microsoft-based workflow around Power Apps, Dataverse, Power Automate, and Power BI because When ZF Group made Power Platform available to all employees, adoption quickly accelerated across the company. Source information is captured from frontline systems, documents, transactions, images, or conversations and then processed with cloud services that classify, summarize, model, or route the data for downstream use. The resulting records are stored in shared business or analytical systems and surfaced through apps, dashboards, or case workflows so staff can move from manual review to faster action while still keeping a governed human-in-the-loop process. This turns scattered data into an operational workflow rather than a static report, making the same platform useful for both daily execution and future scaling, and The challenge was to encourage development without compromising security or quality.

solution_components.name: Power Apps
solution_components.role: Provides tailored low-code apps and workflow front ends for employees, citizens, or service teams.

solution_components.name: Dataverse
solution_components.role: Stores shared low-code business data and application state for Power Platform solutions.

solution_components.name: Power Automate
solution_components.role: Automates event-driven handoffs and repeatable business tasks across the solution.

solution_components.name: Power BI
solution_components.role: Surfaces dashboards and reports so staff can act on shared operational and analytical insight.

data_flow: Source data is captured from frontline systems or content, processed by the Microsoft-based workflow, stored in a shared business or analytical layer, and then surfaced back to staff through apps, dashboards, or case-management experiences.
